# VAREVANT

VAREVANT is an AI automation and implementation partner focused on revenue automation, speed-to-lead, CRM workflow automation, AI agents, and n8n-based orchestration for service businesses and agency partners.

## Primary services
- AI automation for HVAC companies
- AI automation for roofing companies
- Speed-to-lead and lead follow-up automation
- CRM and operational workflow automation
- AI agent implementation
- n8n automation
- White-label technical execution for B2B agencies

## Evidence policy
VAREVANT does not intentionally publish fabricated customers, testimonials, revenue claims, statistics, research, reviews, backlinks, or external endorsements. New case studies and benchmark claims require real supporting evidence.
